beats.vo: Limit orders wait at a price. They do not jump the queue. A market order does not wait. It trades straight away, at the prices people are already offering. The list of those waiting prices is called the book. A cross is the price line touching a rung. A fill is an order actually trading. On the diagram for this beat, look for a waiting marker on a level beside a faded market arrow cutting through. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Write Waits under one rung and Not this tool under the arrow. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Waiting can mean no fill. That outcome belongs in the picture. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Limit orders wait. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.
